description: This file contains benchmark tests for 128-bit integer operations using the Abseil library, including division, remainder, multiplication, and addition for absl::uint128 and absl::int128 types, with special handling for intrinsic 128-bit integers.

classes.name: UniformIntDistribution128
classes.description: A custom distribution class for generating 128-bit integers, used when native support is unavailable.

methods.name: MakeRandomEngine
methods.description: Creates and seeds a Mersenne Twister random number generator.

methods.description: Generates a sample of 128-bit integer pairs for division benchmarks with uniform distribution.

methods.name: BM_RemainderClass128UniformDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark for computing remainders of 128-bit integers with uniform divisor.

methods.name: BM_RemainderClass128SmallDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark for computing remainders of 128-bit integers by small divisors.

methods.name: GetRandomClass128Sample
